detail.longDescription: AI and mental health research is exploring whether changes in voice and language can help detect depression. Models can analyze speech rhythm, pauses, acoustic features and text patterns as digital biomarkers. The promise is earlier support — not autonomous diagnosis. https://www. nexthorizon.space/2025/04/ai-a nd-mental-health-diagnosing-depression-through-voice-and-text.html # Science # Health # Healthcare # Research # AI # MentalHealth # Depression # Psychology # MedTech # Medicine # DigitalHealth
